gaps.explanation: The General Fund budget-and-actual schedule (p8) prints 'Grants and donations' 27,606 among RECEIPTS (printed Total receipts 4,832,759), while the cash-basis governmental funds statement (p4) prints the same 27,606 under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (General Total receipts 4,805,153; Total column 5,042,117), so the JSON statement has it in other_financing. 4,832,759 - 4,805,153 = 27,606 = the gap (schedule 5,069,723 - 27,606 = 5,042,117). The detail line (Budget and Actual - General Fund, 'Grants and donations' 27,606, p8) is a printed schedule line and is kept. Inside the General Fund the schedule also prints Intergovernmental lines totalling 288,539 vs statement 289,547 and Other miscellaneous 19,854 vs statement 18,846; these two 1,008 differences offset (Library state aid 1,008, p11), so they add nothing to the gap. Bond Fund schedule (p9) 236,964 = statement Bond column 236,964.

Statement (accrual, p6 Total column): total operating revenues 2,374,973 + interest income 11,186 + unrealized gain/loss 3,413 = 2,389,572. Detail is the proprietary budget-and-actual schedule on the budgetary basis (p10): Total revenues actual 2,380,488 (Water 665,898 + Sewer 1,714,589; utility sales 2,365,889 + interest 14,599). Difference 9,084 = the accrual increase in accounts receivable (cash flows p7: (In)decrease in accounts receivable (9,084)). No fix.

Statement (accrual, p6 Total column): total operating expenses 1,316,473 (incl. depreciation 118,411) + interest expense 9,566 = 1,326,039. Detail is the budgetary-basis proprietary schedule (p10): Total expenditures actual 1,199,298 printed (Operating 1,251,314 + Capital improvements 2,153,727 + Debt service (2,205,743); detail lines add to 1,199,299, report rounding 1). The budgetary basis has capital improvements and a negative debt service (Water notes payable 2,240,407) instead of depreciation and accrued expenses, so the two printed totals really differ (126,740). No fix.
